title: The DBMS must implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.
check_content:
Verify the DBMS is configured to implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.

If the DBMS is not configured to implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the DBMS to implement the capability to centrally review and analyze audit records from multiple components within the system.
VulnDiscussion: Automated mechanisms for centralized reviews and analyses include Security Information and Event Management products.
